soybean.name: Yellow mosaic virus
soybean.symptoms: Bright yellow patches on young leaves, leaves smaller and stunted plants.
soybean.favours: Whitefly spread the virus, more in warm humid spells.
actions: Pull out and destroy infected plants early so they do not spread the virus.
Reduce whiteflies: use yellow sticky traps and keep field edges weed free.
Next season choose a variety recommended locally as resistant.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

soybean.name: Leaf-eating caterpillars (semilooper or Spodoptera)
soybean.symptoms: Ragged holes in leaves, green caterpillars or egg clusters on leaf undersides.
soybean.favours: Warm humid weather after early rains.
actions: Walk the field and hand-pick egg clusters and young larvae where few.
Use pheromone traps to track moths.
If damage is spreading, get a spray recommendation from your agriculture officer.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

soybean.name: Frogeye leaf spot (fungal)
soybean.symptoms: Round brown spots with grey centres and dark edges on leaves.
actions: Improve air flow and avoid working in the field when leaves are wet.
Remove badly infected leaves and plants.
Use clean seed and rotate crops next season.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

cotton.name: Pink bollworm
cotton.symptoms: Rosette-shaped flowers, small holes in bolls, pink larvae inside.
cotton.favours: Warm weather and continuous cotton planting.
actions: Install pheromone traps and count moths every week.
Collect and destroy damaged squares and bolls.
Do not leave crop residue in the field after picking.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

cotton.name: Whitefly and leaf curl virus
cotton.symptoms: Leaves curl upwards and thicken, sticky leaves, white flies under leaves.
cotton.favours: Hot dry spells and weedy field edges.
actions: Use yellow sticky traps and remove weed hosts.
Remove severely curled plants early.
Avoid over-use of nitrogen, which attracts sucking pests.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

cotton.name: Jassids (sucking pests)
cotton.symptoms: Leaf edges turn yellow-red and curl downward, small green insects under leaves.
actions: Scout 20 plants across the field and count insects per leaf.
Keep the field weed free and avoid excess nitrogen.
Spray only if the count passes the local threshold.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

wheat.name: Yellow (stripe) rust
wheat.symptoms: Yellow powdery stripes along the leaf veins.
wheat.favours: Cool, humid weather with dew or light rain.
actions: Check leaves in the morning and report early to your agriculture officer.
Do not delay: rust spreads fast in cool humid weather.
Next season use rust-resistant varieties.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

wheat.name: Powdery mildew
wheat.symptoms: White powdery patches on leaves and stems.
wheat.favours: Cool humid weather and dense crop.
actions: Avoid excess nitrogen and very dense sowing.
Improve air flow where possible.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

wheat.name: Aphids
wheat.symptoms: Clusters of small green or black insects on leaves and ears, sticky leaves.
actions: Check 10 tillers in 5 places and count aphids.
Natural enemies like ladybird beetles often control light attacks.
Spray only if numbers are high, as advised locally.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

rice.name: Rice blast
rice.symptoms: Diamond-shaped spots with grey centres on leaves, broken necks on panicles.
rice.favours: Cloudy humid weather, heavy nitrogen use.
actions: Avoid applying too much nitrogen at once.
Drain and refill with fresh water, and keep the field weed free.
Check leaves early and report spread to your agriculture officer.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

rice.name: Bacterial leaf blight
rice.symptoms: Yellow to white stripes starting at leaf tips, leaves dry out.
rice.favours: Heavy rain, strong wind and flooding.
actions: Drain the field and avoid excess nitrogen.
Do not move water from infected to healthy plots.
Use disease-free seed next season.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

rice.name: Stem borer
rice.symptoms: Dead hearts in young plants and white empty panicles later.
actions: Install pheromone traps and count moths.
Pull out and destroy dead hearts early.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

maize.name: Fall armyworm
maize.symptoms: Ragged leaf holes and sawdust-like droppings in the whorl, larvae inside.
maize.favours: Warm weather in early crop stages.
actions: Check 20 plants in a zig-zag and note the share with fresh damage.
Hand-pick egg masses and young larvae where numbers are small.
Act early: damage is hardest to control once larvae are large.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

maize.name: Northern leaf blight
maize.symptoms: Long grey-green cigar-shaped spots on leaves.
maize.favours: Moderate temperatures and long humid, dewy spells.
actions: Rotate crops and remove residue after harvest.
Improve air flow and avoid late-evening irrigation.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

maize.name: Common rust
maize.symptoms: Small brick-red pustules on both leaf sides.
actions: Check leaves weekly during humid spells.
Use tolerant hybrids next season.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

tomato.name: Early blight
tomato.symptoms: Dark brown spots with ring patterns on older leaves, yellowing around spots.
tomato.favours: Warm humid weather and wet leaves.
actions: Remove infected lower leaves and burn or bury them.
Water at the base and avoid wetting leaves.
Mulch to stop soil splash and rotate crops.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

tomato.name: Late blight
tomato.symptoms: Large water-soaked dark patches on leaves, white fuzz underneath, firm brown fruit rot.
actions: Act fast: remove and destroy infected plants and fruit.
Avoid overhead watering and improve air flow.
Report spread early to your agriculture officer.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.

tomato.name: Tomato leaf curl virus
tomato.symptoms: Leaves curl upward and shrink, plants stunted, few fruits.
tomato.favours: Whitefly spread, mostly in warm dry weather.
actions: Remove infected plants early.
Use yellow sticky traps and insect-proof nursery nets.
Control weeds around the field.
Use only products registered for this crop and follow the label. Ask your Taluka Agriculture Officer or Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) before spraying.
